summary: SSO backend flows fully validated (17/17 pytest tests pass), Login-page SSO frontend mostly OK. CRITICAL frontend bug: Admin Config → onglet SSO crashes with 'SSOSection is not defined' — the SSOSection component and all data-testid cards (section-sso, sso-google-card, sso-entra-card, sso-saml-card, sso-provisioning-card, sso-autoprovision-toggle, sso-allowed-domains, sso-default-profile, sso-save-btn) are referenced in AdminConfig.jsx line 1135 but never defined/imported anywhere in /app/frontend/src. The admin SSO UI is entirely missing from the frontend code. Minor issue: /login?sso=fakecode does NOT display the 'Code SSO invalide' error although the /api/auth/sso/exchange call returns 401 (twice). Login-regression classic passes.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: SSOSection is not defined — component referenced at line 1135 <SSOSection config={config} onSave={handleSave} /> but never declared or imported. Clicking data-testid='config-tab-sso' crashes the whole admin config page with an uncaught runtime error. All expected data-testid attributes for the SSO admin section are MISSING from the codebase: section-sso, sso-google-card, sso-entra-card, sso-saml-card, sso-provisioning-card, sso-autoprovision-toggle, sso-allowed-domains, sso-default-profile, sso-save-btn.

Navigating to /login?sso=fakecode calls authAPI.ssoExchange which returns 401 twice (visible in console), but the .catch handler's setError does not surface any message via [data-testid='login-error']. Expected: 'Échec de la connexion SSO' / 'Code SSO invalide'. Possibly StrictMode double-mount clearing state or err.response being undefined.
